title: Move Lightbound's Cleanse (dispel grid/list + mouseover key) into LibBound for every class that can dispel
description:
Today it exists only in Lightbound/Cleanse.lua: 974 lines, a grid of SecureGroupHeader cells with a Blizzard AuraContainer filtered to the dispel types, plus a list mode and a mouseover cleanse key.

Every class that can remove debuffs should have it, with a per-addon table of spells and dispel types:
- Priest: Dispel Magic, Cure/Abolish Disease
- Druid: Remove Curse, Cure/Abolish Poison
- Mage: Remove Lesser Curse
- Shaman: Cure Poison/Disease (and totems?)
- Paladin: Cleanse/Purify, as today

Same pattern as Carrot (Lightbound -> LibBound 30): Lightbound drops its own copy and uses the shared one. Spell IDs must be checked on Forever.
notes: Every class that removes debuffs has it (LibBound 39): Lightbound, Spiritbound, Dreambound, Chronobound, Stormbound. Close after the in-game tests.

title: Carrot on a Stick in every Bound addon (from Lightbound)
Shared Cooldown Manager row: Blizzard's buff icons in the addon's skin (stacks and timers in combat)
description:
Forever hides buffs from addons in combat (Maelstrom test 2026-11-21: secret, ForceTaint_Strong). Blizzard's Cooldown Manager (BuffIconCooldownViewer / BuffBarCooldownViewer) draws them itself, so its icons keep working in combat. Idea: a LibBound piece that takes chosen Cooldown Manager icons, skins them (class skin, plain in Blizzard/Flat), and places them as a movable row; each addon lists its spells. Limits: no logic on hidden numbers (no own sound/glow at N stacks); only spells in Forever's cooldown viewer set; reparent/restyle out of combat only.

title: Resource bar in LibBound (rage, energy): Bound.InstallPowerBar with marks
description: Movable bar for rage (Ragebound, Dreambound Bear Form) and energy (Shadowbound, Cat Form): fill + number, marks at chosen costs (e.g. 10 Battle Shout, 15 Heroic Strike), own options page, hides idle at 0. Waiting for Marius' empty-bar art. Risk: UnitPower may be secret in combat on Forever (StatusBar can still draw it; number and marks can't).
notes: Blocked on Marius' bar art (spec given 2026-11-21: 1024x128 canvases, empty/fill/frame/spark/bear-claws). Must support horizontal AND vertical: StatusBar:SetOrientation('VERTICAL') + SetRotatesTexture(true), other layers rotated 90 degrees via texcoords; vertical art optional if the lighting looks wrong rotated.

title: CooldownSkin.lua is unused since Lightbound dropped it: keep or remove?
description: Lightbound dropped its Cooldown Manager page (2026-11-22, Marius: only a look, fought EllesmereUI's Cooldown Manager). No addon calls Bound.InstallCooldownSkin now, and its only tests (Lightbound tests/cdm.scenario.lua) went with it, so the module is untested. Decide: remove CooldownSkin.lua and docs/api/cooldown-skin.md, or keep it with a test in another addon. Findings worth keeping either way: EllesmereUI's CDM hides Blizzard's icons and locks Edit Mode; switching modules needs UnitGUID + C_AddOns.SaveAddOns; EllesmereUI reverts an off module's CVars at login.

title: Options header shows 'v@project-version@' when run from a git checkout
description: The options window header prints the raw ## Version token when the addon runs from git (not a packaged zip). It shows up in every docs screenshot (Ragebound options-*.png). Show nothing, or 'dev', when the version still contains '@'.

title: Cast overlay tooltip says 'Click to cast' for items (poisons, stones, food)
description: The shared overlay tooltip line 'Click to cast (out of combat)' also shows on cards that use an item (Shadowbound poisons, Ragebound stones, Packbound feeding). An optional verb per overlay (cast/use/apply) would read right.

title: LibBound header comments and small inconsistencies found while writing the docs
description: From the docs pass (2026-11-21): NewAddon reads cfg.className (not in Core.lua's header); MakeBuffTimer reads cfg.title (not in BuffTimer.lua's header); InstallSlash indexes cfg.slash[1] without a guard (required but unchecked, like cfg.db); Travel header says columns {} for none but the default when left out is { 'TRAVEL' }; the Hearthstone-only travel fallback needs ns.UI (InstallSkin first), undocumented; the Extras buff key note says party but raids work too; crop_shots.py comment still mentions /bk shots. Docs at antnsn.github.io/LibBound describe the real behaviour.

title: Travel panel: a hidden action row still reserves its height
description: Travel.lua reserves ROW_H for the action row whenever cfg.action exists, but UpdateCounts hides it when cfg.action returns nil, leaving a gap. Packbound always returns a row, so no visible effect today. Found in the ammo-vendor final review.
